label: Aristotle, Physics VIII.4, 255b24-27…: The natural MOTION_2 of a thing not moved by itself, as of…
interpretation: Literal reading: the light and the heavy are moved either by what generated them and made them light or heavy, or by what removed the hindrance (255b35-256a2). The remover moves only per accidens (255b24-27: κατὰ συμβεβηκὸς γὰρ κινεῖ, like the wall that a rebounding ball does not move). Reading steps: the generator is read as a per se mover of the motion in its respect (the place), and the statement is extended from the light and the heavy to every natural motion that is not a self-motion. The inclusive 'or' admits a motion whose only mover is the per accidens remover; excluding that case is not attributed here and is the separate open premise STMT-PER-ACCIDENS-MOVED-PASSIVE-MOTION-HAS-PER-SE-MOVER.
